messages:
Maya L: Quick heads-up — I ran the weekly KB scan and it flagged 2 redirect chains and one 410 image under /guides/runtime. Created a tiny branch with the suggested fix, but need an approver for content validation before I open the PR.
DocsBot: KB scan results: 3 items found — redirect-chain (x2), missing-image (x1). Auto-ticket #KB-4827 created.
Kevin H: thanks Maya. Can you paste the failing URL(s)? I'll check ownership and whether this is safe to edit.
Maya L: sure — failing paths:
`/guides/runtime/configuration#legacy-prefix`
`/guides/runtime/images/setup-arch.png` (returns 410)
I replaced the redirect to point to `/guides/runtime/configuration#current-prefix` and re-uploaded a re-export of the image as `setup-arch-v2.png` in the branch.
Sam P: :eyes: I can review the content side. Is the image re-export lossy? we try to keep svgs for diagrams.
Maya L: re-export is a PNG from original Sketch file — not ideal, but small and inline. If design wants SVG we can follow up; for now PNG keeps the page usable.
Rachel M: FYI the page is included in the canary docs build used by the Dedicated onboarding flow — if we change anchors we should add a compatibility note in the PR so the onboarding script doesn't break.
Josh T: tagging @product because anchor changes can affect onboarding snippets. Product: quick OK to proceed with anchor rename?
Product Bot: Notified product-owners channel.
Kevin H: I can approve content after Sam's review + Rachel's sanity check on onboarding. Maya, please open the PR with `KB-4827` in the title and link the ticket. Add a short migration note and backfill redirect comment in the header.
Maya L: done — PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3245 — added migration note and redirect meta. Sam, PTAL when you have a minute.
Sam P: Reviewing now, should be quick. Will leave comments if any formatting or alt text tweaks needed. :thumbsup: 
DocsBot: CI: docs-build passed for PR 3245 (canary).
Sam P: left a tiny alt-text suggestion. otherwise :shipit: 
Kevin H: Approving now. Rachel, does the onboarding test look happy with the redirect shim?
Rachel M: Ran the onboarding smoke locally against the canary build, no regressions. :tada: 
Maya L: great — merging after CI green. Thanks all!
Josh T: nice quick turnaround :clap: 
Maya L: merged — close KB-4827 when you see the site update.
DocsBot: Ticket KB-4827 updated: resolved by PR 3245.
